intro: Gatehouse Goods is a local Stormwind task involving the transport of a shipment up the stairs within Trias' Cheese. Because the cheese shop shares a floor with the adjacent gatehouse, goods can be quietly dropped outside the stockroom door for guards to collect. The arrangement highlights the tight, interconnected urban design of Stormwind's commercial and defensive quarters.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Yes, it's only a flight of stairs, but if it's such a small ask, it should be no problem for you to finish the delivery yourself!
Trias' Cheese isn't part of the Gatehouse or their stocking inventory, but our buildings share a floor.
Place the crate outside their stockroom door--the guard will send someone for a regular pickup. They will see the package arrival and carry it inside as they return to post.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yep. There's a reason that hinge opens inwards towards them, so they don't get the door blocked by people leaving stuff anywhere they please.
We respect your business, and expect you to respect ours.
